messages:
sam (eng lead): Heads-up — we need a 45m retrospective for last week's serving-cluster CPU incident. Options: Tue 10:00am PST or Wed 4:00pm PST. Who should attend? I'll invite SRE, oncall, infra eng, product, and support.

maya (pm): Please include the PMs who own the affected features. Also add a slot specifically for reviewing follow-up actions.

ryan (engineer): 45m sounds good. Prefer Tue 10am. If that doesn't work for others, Wed 4 is my backup.

lena (oncall): I can do Tue. Can folks please share the pre-read logs and flamegraphs ahead of time?

zoe (support): Support coverage ok for Tue, I can bring customer timelines and ticket excerpts.

maya (pm): Agree on agenda shape: RCA walkthrough, timeline + impact, actions & owners, quick retro on process.

sam (eng lead): Draft agenda below — take or leave, but we should lock a structure so people can prep:

```
1) Quick context (5m)
2) RCA walk-through (15m)
3) Timeline & customer impact (10m)
4) Actions & owners (10m)
5) Wrap + follow-ups (5m)
```

ryan (engineer): I'll prepare a short list of mitigation proposals to discuss.

lena (oncall): I'll attach perf graphs and the heavy-request traces before the meeting. Ping me with any slices you want.

sam (eng lead): @maya @zoe @ryan @lena ack? I'll create the calendar invite once we confirm. :calendar: 

maya (pm): Ack — Tue 10am works for our PMs. Please include a link to the postmortem doc in the invite.

devops-bot: Incident #INC-2026-217 created: serving-cluster-cpu-high — postmortem draft available at https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-217

sam (eng lead): Ok locking next Tue 10:00am PST (45m). Invite sent. Notes: bring proposed remediation priorities and an owner for each action. I'll facilitate.

zoe (support): Thanks — I'll add customer impact notes to the doc and highlight affected accounts.

ryan (engineer): I'll be there. Assign me follow-up: autoscale tuning proposal.

lena (oncall): I'll own runbook updates and cockpit alert thresholds.

maya (pm): I'll own communication improvements and a playbook for PMs for incident comms.

sam (eng lead): Great. If anyone can't make it, flag here and we'll either record or reschedule.

zoe (support): All good from my side.

sam (eng lead): Meeting created: https://calendar.google.com/event?id=abc123 — pre-reads link in the postmortem doc above. :white_check_mark:
